findings: Within a fixed alpha/non-alpha layout, measured wrapping stays inside fixed row slots; unused continuation rows remain reserved and final overflow is visibly ellipsized.
Raster, shader detail, optional telemetry and queue disposition rows have fixed positions. Alpha/non-alpha layouts intentionally differ.
Native placement uniformly scales the full bitmap to fit the visible picture; no minimum readable font size is guaranteed. Small windows can make the complete panel unreadably small.
Nominal size derives from configured screen height, but containment and anchoring use current target.crop. Actual movie geometry changes can still move or shrink the entire panel.
Fixed slots cannot expose arbitrary-length values completely. Shader list shows bounded detail and a remaining-count summary. Ellipsis is intentional, not full-value disclosure.
improvementsWithoutTelemetryDrivenLabelM: Use explicit user-selected compact/details layouts with stable row maps; do not automatically remove rows when values become unavailable.
Expose full truncated values in a separate inspector or diagnostic report; keep the existing panel fields fixed.
If a responsive layout is later needed, choose it only from viewport size with stable breakpoints rather than telemetry content; validate text readability and transition behavior separately.
limits: Existing placement tests prove containment, not readable text at arbitrary window sizes.
No live windowed/fullscreen visual check or app launch was performed in this review.
No layout or presentation behavior was changed by this review.
